title: Shadows of Self
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: The fifth Mistborn novel and the second in the Wax and Wayne era, set in a growing industrial city. A series of killings, and rising political unrest, demand that the lawman and his irreverent partner dig deeper.
readIf: you're following the Wax and Wayne books and want a smart, fast mystery with gunfights.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier Mistborn books, as this builds on them closely.

pairings.reason: Another fast-paced fantasy with a detective's instincts and wisecracks in a city under pressure.
A more inventive murder mystery in a fantasy empire, focused on a pair of investigators.
If you like the sparring partners and the intricate plans, this has a crew of thieves with the same energy.
